info.title: API.SH: Pexels
info.description: The Pexels API from API.SH: public Pexels data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Pexels photo or video by id or link: title, description, alt text, size, duration and frame rate for videos, dates, license, colors, tags, preview images and preview clip, the photographer, view, download and like counts, camera details (make, model, aperture, focal length, ISO, shutter speed, software, date taken, place name and place id, file size), the slugs of the page in other languages, and the download links: `download_url` (the site's download link), `original_url` (the full-size file) and for videos every file (`video_files`: quality, size, frame rate, link). GPS coordinates are not included.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pexels-media

get.description:
Free stock photos or videos on Pexels for keywords, with the site's filters (orientation, number and age of people, upload date, minimum/maximum width and height for photos; duration, frame rate and resolution for videos) and sort: id, title, description, alt text, link, width, height, duration and frame rate for videos, created and published dates, license, featured flag, main color and palette, tags, preview images (small, medium, large), a preview clip and every video file for videos, download links (`download_url`, `original_url`), and the photographer (id, name, profile link, avatar, social handles, hero badges). Also the totals per media type, related searches with counts and the filters applied. 24 per page; the site serves the first 20 pages of a search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page. Download links and original files are not included.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pexels-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-20). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Site language for titles and the search, e.g. `en-US` (default), `de-DE`, `pt-BR`, `ja-JP`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
